idea-plugin.name: MavenUp
idea-plugin.description:
Simplify Maven dependency and plugin management with a clear overview and one-click updates.

Core Features:

  • Complete Dependency Overview: Displays all dependencies, plugins, and parent POM across Maven modules in an organized table.
  • Find & Update Versions: Discover newer versions in Maven Central and private repositories, then apply a configurable auto-selection strategy (disabled, highest version, or latest minor in the current major line), bulk-select the highest major, highest minor, or current version for all dependencies at once, or set the highest major or minor version—or reset to the current version—for a single dependency straight from its row context menu.
  • Security Scanning: Check dependencies and transitive components for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev and Sonatype OSS Index.
  • Smart Navigation: Jump directly to pom.xml definitions or open artifacts in Maven Repository browsers with a single click.

Advanced Capabilities:

  • Property-Aware Versions: Recognizes and updates Maven properties (e.g., ${spring.version}) across all references.
  • Flexible Filtering & Sorting: Filter by name, type, pending changes, available updates, or security findings—including whether a dependency is affected itself or only through its transitive dependencies—quickly filter by a right-clicked GroupId, ArtifactId, or Property via the row context menu, clear every filter with a single reset button, and sort any column ascending, descending, or back to the original pom.xml order to quickly locate the dependencies you need.
  • Optional Downgrades: Enable an "offer all versions" setting to also list versions older than the current one when a rollback is needed; the current version is marked in the selection dropdown.
  • Repository Browser Options: Choose between MVN Repository and Sonatype Central for artifact links.
  • Private Repository Support: Access authenticated repositories from settings.xml with fallback to standard Maven user settings.
  • Detailed Security Reports: View advisories in a master-detail split view with severity, CVSS scores and vector, CWE identifiers, publish/last-modified dates, summaries, detailed descriptions, affected version ranges, fixed-in versions, references, and a link to open the affected component in the configured repository browser, with the severity column color-coded to match the tool window.
  • Transitive Vulnerabilities View: A dedicated Transitive CVEs tool window tab lists all transitive dependencies with known vulnerabilities, including type, vulnerability count, and an editable new-version column that highlights the recommended fix in the dropdown and pins a chosen version in dependencyManagement; narrow the list with its own filter row, select the highest major, highest minor, or recommended fix version—for all visible coordinates via the toolbar or a single one via its row context menu—and reset selections.
  • Secure Token Storage: API tokens are stored safely in IntelliJ Password Safe.
  • Global Settings: Configure behavior, filters, and integrations under Settings | Tools | MavenUp to apply across all projects.
  • Responsive UI & Restart-Free: Background processing and dynamic loading ensure smooth operation and updates without IDE restart.
  • Privacy-First Design: Only Maven coordinates are transmitted for version checks and vulnerability scans—your source code remains private.
